quote: Sinomach subsidiary China Machinery Engineering Corporation (CMEC) has concluded construction of the Uyuni lithium carbonate plant in Bolivia. The cutting-edge facility boasts a battery-grade lithium carbonate production line capable of generating an impressive annual output of 15,000 tons.
note: Opened Sinomach English page; CMEC Uyuni 15,000 tpa plant completed; CapEx blank.
